description: This file defines the main entry point for a console application that manages a worker pool, process lifecycle, and plugin loading within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions for WorkerPoolImplementation, ConsoleOptions, and ProcessFlow, and contains the main function that initializes and runs the process based on command-line arguments.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Implements a worker pool with IPC server capabilities, thread dispatching, and lifecycle management within the process.

classes.name: ConsoleOptions
classes.description: Handles command-line argument parsing and configuration for the process, including paths, interface IDs, and other parameters.

classes.name: ProcessFlow
classes.description: Manages the overall process lifecycle, including startup, shutdown, plugin loading, and message handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; parses arguments, sets up environment, and initiates the process lifecycle.
